rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone who is gifted or naturally talented.

example.english: They've been talented since they were little.
example.traditional: 佢由細到大都好有天份。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hou2 jau5 tin1 fan6

rows.note: Use this especially when praising someone’s impressive creative, artistic, or intellectual ability.

example.english: Ming is really talented at painting.
example.traditional: 阿明畫畫真係好有才華。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 waa6 waa2 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 coi4 waa4
